text:
One of my favourite uses for AI is arguing with 25-year-old industrial machinery in German.

Old machines usually come with old manuals, weird parameter names, incomplete documentation and, if you're lucky, a PDF scanned sometime around 2007.

I don't need AI to tell me how a machine works.

I need it to chew through 200 pages, translate the German, cross-reference a parameter list and help me find the three things I actually care about.

That's when it gets useful.

AI isn't replacing the technician.

It's replacing 45 minutes of swearing at a PDF.

Mostly.
